action: I travel to the kingdom of Zarnoth.

verdict.why: scene_set=MISSING; narration mentions Zarnoth=true (canon-or-not judged by hand)

response.narration: You turn from the parapet and set your feet on the north road, but the word Zarnoth meets only silence. Captain Orrel, a day behind you and still leaning on the stone, frowns and shakes his head. 'Never heard of it. The six kingdoms are all the roads I know, and none of them wears that name.' Below, the grey river runs on, and the road beyond the bridge forks without a sign to say which way leads anywhere you've named. You hold your ground and consider where to start.
response.gm_note: Zarnoth is not one of Vaeltharion's six kingdoms (Kaldrath, Verdance, Ashenveil, Aurelis, Tidemark, Sundrach), so no travel occurred. Kessra remains at the Toll Bridge and may name a real destination or ask around.
